eval.title: FB Stock Analysis 2022 - Growth To VALUE !?!?!

call.headline_quote: it's not even close to my top five and that's why i'm not going to add facebook here because yes there is risk and reward but it hasn't improved

base_metric.name: eps
base_metric.quote: i expected earnings of 15.8 dollars the earnings now are 13.6 or 13 point something

scenarios.name: best
scenarios.quote: let's say seven percent at the beginning and then 15 on the metaverse good terminal multiple then yes facebook is still let's say a buy but that's the best case scenario

scenarios.name: worst
scenarios.quote: if they don't manage to go to growth zero growth zero growth and this is unlikely if there is zero growth there will be actually decline in earnings and then the market gives a bad terminal multiple

what_is_priced_in.quote: market capitalization 631 billion dollars and price earnings ratio at the moment of 16.8

reasons.claim: Lowering the growth estimate from 20% to 7% while keeping the multiple sharply cuts intrinsic value versus the price, so the risk/reward has not improved despite the crash.
reasons.quote: if we keep the multiple so just this decline in growth if we keep the same multiple it significantly changes the intrinsic value

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: expected eps (old)

reasons.claim: The 'delta of the delta' effect means a drop in growth expectations causes a double hit from both lower earnings and a lower multiple, crashing growth stocks hard.
reasons.quote: if that reverts and the expectation gets lower there is a double whammy there of a lower price earnings ratio to lower earnings to lower growth to lower estimation and the stock crashes significantly

reasons.claim: User attention/time spent, not just user counts, has been hit as Facebook flooded platforms with ads and users like himself disengage, threatening the ad business's core driver.
reasons.quote: given the increase in ads i think there has been a severe hit to your attention to your spent time on the platforms which creates significant risk for facebook

reasons.claim: Heavy, uncertain investment in the metaverse/Reality Labs is like venture capital spending with no near-term returns, unlike Amazon's investment in existing demand.
reasons.quote: facebooking is investing in something completely out of the blue and that's also a risk it's like a venture capitalist investment and not a big growth business with certain cash flows

data_check.gap_note: he says 4.4e+10, as-of -4.4537e+10 (FY2021); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Whether Reels can win back attention from TikTok is unknown, not just uncertain, which he treats as a genuine investment risk.
reasons.quote: will they do it the first time when they are behind come back and really be the platform where people go to that's again an unknown it's not uncertainty they will do it or not it's really an unknown

external_facts_used: Sven's wife's report that Facebook flooded her platforms with ads
Facebook's non-response to a privacy/scammer report
Howard Marks's letter quote on low valuation not equaling value
Amazon's ~$50 billion capex vs Facebook's ~$40 billion

critic.notes: ok. Reason 3 quote drops ASR stutter ('scree which'). external_facts attributes letter to Howard Marks; transcript says 'set carmen' (Seth Klarman) — outside-knowledge slip, not a reason.
